assessment: This important study presents an interesting example of how complexities of communities may be reduced by showing that when partner species exert a negative effect on the focal species, the joint effects are generally not additive, but rather dominated by the strongest single effect. The evidence, enabled by thousands of measurements using nanodroplet-based microfluidics, is compelling, although the generality of the conclusion awaits further studies. This paper is of interest to microbial ecologists and synthetic biologists.
